questions.stem: What is the SI unit of time?
questions.solution: The SI unit of time is the second, which is the standard unit used in scientific measurements. Minutes and hours are commonly used but are not part of the International System of Units. Ghatika is an ancient unit of time and not an SI unit.

hi.stem: समय का एसआई मात्रक क्या है?
hi.solution: समय का एसआई मात्रक सेकंड है, जो वैज्ञानिक मापन में मानक मात्रक है। मिनट और घंटा सामान्य रूप से उपयोग में लिए जाते हैं लेकिन इंटरनेशनल यूनिट सिस्टम के हिस्से नहीं हैं। घटिका एक प्राचीन समय का मात्रक है और एसआई मात्रक नहीं है।
hi.critique: All terms are standard in Hindi science textbooks. 'घटिका' is a recognized ancient unit, not an SI unit. 'सेकंड' is the standard translation for 'second'.

mr.solution: वेळेचे एसआय एकक सेकंद आहे, जे वैज्ञानिक मोजणीसाठी मानक एकक आहे. मिनिट आणि तास सामान्यतः वापरले जातात पण ते आंतरराष्ट्रीय एकक प्रणालीचा भाग नाहीत. घटिका एक जुने वेळेचे एकक आहे आणि एसआय एकक नाही.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate Marathi equivalents for technical terms like 'second' (सेकंद) and 'ghatika' (घटिका).

questions.stem: A car covers 60 km in the first hour, 70 km in the second hour, and 50 km in the third hour. What can be said about the car's motion?
choices: The car is in uniform motion
The car's speed is constant throughout
The car is in non-uniform motion
The car's average speed is 60 km/h
questions.solution: The car is in non-uniform motion because it covers unequal distances in equal intervals of time. The first option is incorrect as uniform motion requires equal distances in equal intervals. The second option is incorrect as the speed changes. The fourth option is incorrect as the average speed would be (60+70+50)/3 = 60 km/h, but the motion is still non-uniform.

questions.stem: What is the SI unit of speed?
questions.solution: The SI unit of speed is metre per second, or m/s. km/h and cm/s are other units, but not the SI unit. km/s is not a standard unit for speed in this context.

questions.stem: In a 100 m race, runner A covers the distance in 10 seconds, and runner B covers the same distance in 12 seconds. Who is faster?
questions.solution: Runner A is faster because they covered the same distance in less time, which means they have a higher speed. Runner B took longer to cover the same distance, so they are slower. The other options either contradict the relationship between time and speed or are not supported by the given information.

questions.stem: A car travels 100 km in 2 hours. It then travels 150 km in 3 hours. What is the average speed of the car for the entire journey?
questions.solution: The total distance is 100 km + 150 km = 250 km, and the total time is 2 hours + 3 hours = 5 hours. Average speed = total distance / total time = 250 km / 5 h = 50 km/h. 40 km/h and 60 km/h are incorrect calculations, and 70 km/h is not supported by the data.

hi.stem: एक कार 2 घंटे में 100 किमी की दूरी तय करती है। फिर वह 3 घंटे में 150 किमी की दूरी तय करती है। पूरी यात्रा के लिए कार की औसत गति क्या है?
hi.solution: कुल दूरी 100 किमी + 150 किमी = 250 किमी है, और कुल समय 2 घंटे + 3 घंटे = 5 घंटे है। औसत गति = कुल दूरी / कुल समय = 250 किमी / 5 घंटा = 50 किमी/घंटा। 40 किमी/घंटा और 60 किमी/घंटा गलत गणना हैं, और 70 किमी/घंटा आंकड़ों द्वारा समर्थित नहीं है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses standard Hindi technical terms for speed and distance.

mr.stem: एक गाडी 2 तासात 100 किमी जाते. नंतर ती 3 तासात 150 किमी जाते. पूर्ण प्रवासासाठी गाडीची सरासरी वेग किती असेल?
mr.solution: एकूण अंतर 100 किमी + 150 किमी = 250 किमी आहे आणि एकूण वेळ 2 तास + 3 तास = 5 तास आहे. सरासरी वेग = एकूण अंतर / एकूण वेळ = 250 किमी / 5 तास = 50 किमी/तास. 40 किमी/तास आणि 60 किमी/तास चुकीच्या गणना आहेत, आणि 70 किमी/तास डेटाने समर्थित नाही.
mr.critique: The Marathi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as would be found in a Marathi-medium textbook.
